title: Home practical guide and safety card: potato osmosis
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
unit: Spring 2: Transport, the periodic table and waves
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 112 (Home practical guide and safety card: potato osmosis (portal worksheet; adult cuts, do not taste))
intro: Lesson 112: Diffusion and osmosis: review and practical. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see how potato pieces change mass in salt and pure water
equipment: A potato (adult cuts into equal pieces)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult cuts four equal potato pieces
Put pieces in cups of pure water and increasing salt solutions
Leave for 2 hours; do not taste
Work out the % change in mass

questions.q: Big question: why does salt pull water out of cells?
questions.a: Osmosis: water moves from dilute cell contents to the concentrated salt outside.
